findings.text: commits_between duplicates the range reader the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:504 (reviewed_commits): the same git log --reverse --format invocation and the same (sha, subject) parse loop, and this call site used that owner before the change; only the excluding flag and that owner's first_parent differ. The addition duplicates the owner instead of extending it; the repair is to add an excluding argument to reviewed_commits and delete the copy.

the failing-at-base leg of this assertion is not recorded in any gate log: the manifest's baseline arm log logs/baseline-suite.log runs only tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, so 'failing at the base revision' rests on a quoted refusal rather than a filed run. I reproduced it at 622ef4617d with this file copied in: 1 failed, 1 passed, the refusal naming peer commit 18abc0908; the base-red log belongs in the manifest's evidence.

_shared_branch_revision reads the shared checkout's current branch through recovery_classification._primary_branch_revision (recovery_classification.py:1067), which resolves the checked-out branch's commit rather than the primary ref itself; a shared checkout left on a feature branch therefore subtracts that branch's history and the primary commits the run merged are cited again, returning the refusal this node removes. The reader is pre-existing, but the node's new use depends on it.
